mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_score_result ( user_id, date, score, feedback, calorieAnalysis, nutrientAnalysis, suggestions1, suggestions2, suggestions3, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{date}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{calorieAnalysis}, #{nutrientAnalysis}, #{suggestions1}, #{suggestions2}, #{suggestions3}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), feedback = VALUES(feedback), calorieAnalysis = VALUES(calorieAnalysis), nutrientAnalysis = VALUES(nutrientAnalysis), suggestions1 = VALUES(suggestions1), suggestions2 = VALUES(suggestions2), suggestions3 = VALUES(suggestions3), created_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, date, score, feedback, calorieAnalysis, nutrientAnalysis, suggestions1, suggestions2, suggestions3, created_at FROM diet_score_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date}
